en: Sepia-toned view of a fortified Chinese city gate with an upper pavilion, ox carts and people passing through a stone arch, captioned in Russian and English: 'Views and types of Manchuria. Girin. The town-gate.' The reverse is a Russian Empire UPU postcard with red pre-1918 Russian orthography, space for a stamp, censorship approval dated 12 March 1903, and the printer 'T-vo Golike i Vilʹborg.'
